channel.title: Computer Science Extra :: KS LEAPES
channel.description: Ready to put your Scratch skills to the test? We will program a bunch of advanced puzzles like Pac-Man AI, Bubble Sort, and smart pathfinding path algorithms. You’ll tackle hands-on challenges to make sprites navigate mazes, sort data visually, and dodge ghosts — all with the same drag-and-drop coding blocks you already know.
